text: Professor, I hope you don’t mind me asking, but I wanted to get your opinion on something. Of course not. What is it? I’m considering going to graduate school for English literature and I was wondering if you could tell me about your experience in the graduate program at your school. It was a great experience. I was in one of the top programs, I got to work closely with some really amazing scholars, and my advisor was fantastic. We worked on my book project together and they helped me get it published. That sounds amazing! But was it worth the cost? It’s expensive to go to a prestigious graduate school. Yeah, it was definitely worth it. The connections I made there have been invaluable throughout my career. Plus, it’s always good to have a degree from a prestigious school when you’re applying for jobs. That’s true. But I’m not sure if I can get into a school like that. You should definitely try! You’ll never know if you could have gotten in if you don’t even apply. Alright, thank you for your advice, Professor!
